component.name: I Have Issues
component.summary: A document-based issue tracker for small projects

description.p: I Have Issues keeps a project's bugs, features, tasks and questions in a single .issues file that lives beside the code in git. The format is plain JSON, written deterministically so that saving a document produces a clean diff rather than a rewritten file.

Issues are grouped into Open and Resolved, each carrying a type, priority, status, reporter, area, labels, assignees, a milestone, an estimate, and free-text description, reproduction steps, environment, notes and resolution sections. Documents can be exported as Markdown, and legacy hand-written Markdown issue lists can be imported once.
Issues can be pushed to a GitHub repository. The push is one-way; the personal access token is kept in the system wallet and is never written into the document.
The same .issues files are read and written by the Apple, Android and Haiku versions of this application.
